''R6'' - tonygubs |rarity = {{Color|Common}} |looped = Yes |moveable = No |music = Yes |interactable = No |oldmusic = '''Music Version 1''' [[File:Tower Defense Simulator OST - Orange Justice Version 1|thumb|center|250px]] |newmusic = '''Music Version 2''' [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Orange Justice|thumb|center|250px]] }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Its also a great workout.|Inventory Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Orange Justice''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that is bundled with the Meme Emotes gamepass which can be bought for {{Robux|55}}. It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/68642562/profile tonygubs]. The emote is looped and music can be heard while performing the emote. You cannot move while performing this emote. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Animations}} OrangeJustice.gif|First version (19 July 2019 – 29 October 2020) }} ==Trivia== *This [[Emotes|emote]] was based on an emote with the [[w:c:Fortnite:Orange Justice|same name]] from the game ''Fortnite''. *This was one of the first emotes to be added to the game. ==Update History== *'''19 July 2019''' - [[BETA v1.6|BETA v1.6.0]] **'''Orange Justice''' added. *'''22 July 2019''' - [[BETA v1.6|BETA v1.6.1]] **Music replaced. *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **Music removed. *'''9 November 2019''' - [[Release v1.2|Release v1.2.0]] **Music re-added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **Animation replaced. **Now obtained from the Meme Emotes gamepass ({{Robux|200}}) instead of costing {{Robux|100}}. *'''22 March 2022''' - [[v1.1.0]]e **Music removed. *'''7 June 2022''' - [[v1.2.4]]c **Music re-added. *'''24 February 2024''' - [[v1.14.0]] **Cost decreased from {{Robux|200}} to {{Robux|100}}. *'''23 May 2024''' - [[v1.23.0]] **Cost decreased from {{Robux|100}} to {{Robux|70}}. *'''2 August 2026''' - [[v2.4.0|v2.4.2a]] **Cost decreased from {{Robux|70}} to {{Robux|55}}. {{EmoteNavBox}}
